_comment: PUBLIC billing config delivered to every device (like firebase-config.json). Stripe Payment Link URLs are public checkout URLs, safe to commit. To GO LIVE with real charging: create a Stripe Payment Link for each plan/top-up id below and paste its URL as the value. While 'links' is empty, checkout runs the page's preview activation (no charge). Each Payment Link must set client_reference_id passthrough enabled and point its webhook at the deployed stripeWebhook function so ACUs are credited on payment.
